questions.stem:
—Have you _______ your homework yet?
—Yes, I _______ it an hour ago.
questions.explanation: 第一空：yet是现在完成时的标志词，结构为have/has+过去分词，所以用finished；第二空：ago是一般过去时的标志词，所以用finished。解题技巧：记住时间标志词——现在完成时常用already/yet/ever/never/since/for；一般过去时常用yesterday/ago/last week/in 2020。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The book _______ is on the desk belongs to my sister.
questions.explanation: 先行词是the book（物），且在定语从句中作主语，所以用which或that。who/whom用于指人，whose表示"……的"，在从句中作定语。解题技巧：定语从句选择关系词，先看先行词是人还是物，再看关系词在从句中充当什么成分（主语、宾语、定语或状语）。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The 2026 World Cup _______ in the United States, Canada and Mexico.
questions.explanation: 世界杯是"被举办"，需要用被动语态（be+过去分词）。2026年是将来时间，所以用一般将来时的被动语态will be held。A和B是主动语态，D是一般现在时被动，表示经常性动作，不符合语境。解题口诀：被动语态be done，时态体现在be上面。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem:
—Is that Mr. Wang knocking at the door?
—It _______ be him. He has gone to Shanghai on business.
questions.explanation: 根据后句"他去上海出差了"可知，敲门的不可能是他。can't表示否定推测，意为"不可能"；must表示肯定推测"一定"；might表示不确定推测"可能"；mustn't表示禁止"不许"。解题技巧：情态动词表推测时，must用于肯定句表"一定"，can't用于否定句表"不可能"，might/may表"可能"。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The math problem was so difficult that it took me two hours to _______ it.
questions.explanation: work out意为"算出、解决"，符合语境"解数学题"。look for寻找；give up放弃；put off推迟。解题技巧：通过上下文逻辑（math problem/difficult/took two hours）判断需要"解决"之意，注意work out是动副短语，代词放中间，名词可放中间或后面。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: Please _______ the lights when you leave the classroom.
questions.explanation: turn off关闭（电器），符合语境"离开教室关灯"。turn on打开；turn up调大（音量）；turn down调小（音量）或拒绝。解题技巧：turn相关短语要区分清楚——on/off对应开关，up/down对应大小或拒绝。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: We should speak to old people _______ and patiently.
questions.explanation: 此处修饰动词speak，需要用副词形式。polite是形容词，politely是副词，impolite是反义词形容词，politeness是名词。and连接并列结构，后面是patiently（副词），前面也应用副词。解题技巧：-ly是常见副词后缀，形容词变副词通常加ly（以le结尾的改e为y，如gentle-gently）。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.explanation: 根据后文"didn't want to join"（不想参加）可知，起初一些学生认为这是"无聊的"。boring修饰事物，表示"令人厌烦的"；interesting有趣的；relaxing放松的；exciting令人兴奋的。B、C、D都是积极词汇，与didn't want to join逻辑不符。解题技巧：完形填空要注意情感线索和逻辑关系，后文的转折词However也暗示了前面的负面态度。
questions.label: 完形填空
questions.group_passage:
Last month, our school started a green project called "Zero Waste Classroom". The goal was to help students understand the importance of protecting the environment.

Every class was asked to collect recyclable materials such as paper, plastic bottles and old books. At first, some students thought it was (8)___ and didn't want to join. However, after the teacher explained how these wastes could be reused, they changed their minds.

My class did an excellent job. We (9)___ a creative robot using old boxes and bottles. It stood in the corner of our classroom to remind everyone to think twice before throwing things away. Our headteacher was (10)___ impressed that she took photos of it and showed them to the whole school.

Through this activity, we learned that small actions can make a big (11)___. Now, most students in our school have developed good habits. They no longer drop litter everywhere. (12)___, they put it into different bins according to the type of waste.

questions.explanation: 根据上下文，用旧盒子和瓶子"制作"机器人，made是make的过去式，表示"制作"。bought买；found发现；sold卖。因为是环保项目，利用废旧材料制作，所以是made而非bought。解题技巧：注意上下文语境中的动作逻辑，利用废旧材料应该是"制作"而非"购买"。

questions.explanation: 考查固定句型so...that...（如此……以至于……）。班主任如此印象深刻，以至于她拍了照片。very非常；too太（表示过分，常含否定意味）；quite相当。只有so能与that搭配引导结果状语从句。解题口诀：so...that...如此以至于，结果状语要牢记。

questions.stem: How many hours of sleep do teenagers need every night according to the passage?
questions.explanation: 细节理解题。根据文章第二段第一句"According to a recent study, teenagers need 8 to 10 hours of sleep every night."可知，青少年每晚需要8-10小时睡眠。解题技巧：细节题要准确定位，在原文中找到与题干对应的关键词（teenagers/hours of sleep），然后比对选项和原文信息，注意数字细节。
questions.label: 阅读-细节理解
questions.group_passage:
Do you often stay up late to finish your homework? Many students think sleeping less gives them more time to study. However, scientists say this idea is wrong.

According to a recent study, teenagers need 8 to 10 hours of sleep every night. During sleep, the brain works to store information learned during the day. If you don't get enough sleep, your brain cannot do this job well. As a result, you may find it hard to remember new knowledge the next day.

Dr. Li, a sleep expert from Beijing, explains that lack of sleep also affects concentration. "When students feel sleepy in class, they miss important points," he says. "Even if they spend more hours studying at night, the efficiency is much lower."

So what should we do? First, make a proper study plan and start homework earlier. Second, create a good sleeping environment—keep the room dark and quiet. Third, avoid using electronic devices before bed. The blue light from phones and computers makes it harder to fall asleep (入睡).

Remember, good sleep is not a waste of time. It is an important part of successful learning.

questions.stem: The underlined word "efficiency" in Paragraph 3 probably means _______ in Chinese.
questions.explanation: 词义猜测题。根据上下文"即使他们花更多时间学习，效率也低得多"，结合前文提到的"上课打瞌睡错过重点"，可推断efficiency意为"效率"。解题技巧：词义猜测要通过上下文逻辑（even if引导的让步状语从句暗示转折对比）和常识（睡眠不足导致学习效率低）来判断，不要孤立地看单词。

options: A. Students should never use phones before bed
B. Sleeping well helps students study better
C. Homework is not important for students
D. All students in China stay up late every day
questions.explanation: 推理判断题。根据全文内容，尤其是最后一段"good sleep is not a waste of time. It is an important part of successful learning"可推断出睡眠好有助于学习更好。A项never过于绝对，文中只说avoid using而非never use；C项与文意相反；D项all过于绝对。解题技巧：推理题要基于原文但高于原文，注意选项中绝对化的词（never/all/always）通常是干扰项，选择概括性、推断性的合理结论。

questions.stem: What is the best title for this passage?
options: A. How to Finish Homework on Time
B. The Importance of Sleep for Students
C. Why Students Like Staying Up Late
D. How to Use Electronic Devices
questions.explanation: 主旨大意题。文章主要讲述睡眠不足的危害以及充足睡眠对学习和记忆的重要性，因此B项"睡眠对学生的重要性"最能概括全文。A、D只是文章提到的细节建议，C只是开头提到的现象而非主旨。解题技巧：主旨题要把握全文核心，通常看首尾段和各段首句，排除以偏概全的选项（只涉及某段内容的）和过度推断的选项。

questions.explanation: 考查段落主题句。下文提到"你可以从体育社团、艺术社团、科学社团等众多社团中选择"，说明本句应总述学校有多种社团，A项"我们学校有各种各样的社团"符合语境。解题技巧：选句填空要注意段落结构，首句通常为主题句或过渡句，后文的具体列举（sports clubs, art clubs...）提示前文是总述。
questions.label: 短文填空
questions.group_passage:
Joining school clubs is a great way to enrich your middle school life. (17)___ You can choose from sports clubs, art clubs, science clubs and many more.

(18)___ First, it helps you develop new skills. For example, if you join the photography club, you will learn how to take better photos. Second, you can make friends who share similar interests. (19)___ You can exchange ideas and help each other improve.

However, you should balance club activities with your studies. (20)___ Choose one or two clubs that you really like instead of joining too many.

options: A. There are various clubs in our school.
B. It offers you many benefits.
C. Don't spend all your time on clubs.
D. These friends can support your learning.
E. Working with teammates is always enjoyable.
questions.explanation: 考查过渡句。下文用First, Second列举参加社团的好处（develop new skills, make friends），所以本句应总述参加社团有很多好处，B项"它给你提供很多好处"符合。解题技巧：注意后文的信号词First, Second，这提示前文是总述句，后文是并列列举具体好处。
